description: This file defines an abstract class 'AccessStrategy' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Maintenance\AccessStrategy'. It encapsulates common functionality for different access strategies, including entity management, parameter handling, and data retrieval methods. The class is designed to be extended by other concrete strategy implementations that specify specific access logic.

classes.name: AccessStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class that provides a base for defining various access strategies related to maintenance, offering methods for parameter handling, entity class management, data retrieval, and formatting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the access strategy with an entity class name and an information array containing match criteria and parameters.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses; defines how to access data based on employee number.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns the current parameters array used in the strategy.

methods.name: getEntityClassName
methods.description: Returns the name of the entity class associated with this strategy.

methods.name: getMatchBy
methods.description: Returns the array defining match criteria.

methods.name: getMaintenanceService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the MaintenanceService instance used in data operations.

methods.name: getMatchByValues
methods.description: Constructs a mapping of match fields to the employee number, including join information if available.

methods.name: getEntityRecords
methods.description: Uses MaintenanceService to extract data related to an employee number for a given table.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Dynamically loads a formatter class and returns its formatted value for the provided current value.

methods.name: addRecordsToArray
methods.description: Converts an access entity into an associative array based on the strategy's parameters and formatting.
